results.title: Relay Attack on Keyless Fob (125kHz LF / 433MHz UHF)
results.asset: Keyless Door Locking & Engine Start Signal
results.attack_path: Attacker uses dual-transceiver relay RF hardware to extend key fob signal range up to 100m.
results.csg: CSG-01: Protect against LF/UHF signal relay attacks using Time-of-Flight (UWB) distance bounding.

results.title: RF Replay Attack on Unencrypted Unlock Code
results.attack_path: SDR (Software Defined Radio) captures rolling code frame and replays sequence during RF jam.
results.csg: CSG-02: Ensure strict freshness value manager (FVM) and anti-replay counters on RF frames.

results.title: UDS SecurityAccess Key Bruteforce on Door ECU
results.attack_path: OBD-II diagnostic tool sends Seed-Key request 0x27 and bruteforces 16-bit key.
results.csg: CSG-03: Implement 32-bit/128-bit HSM Seed-Key algorithm with exponential penalty delay per failed attempt.

results.title: CAN Frame Injection & Spoofing on Powertrain Bus
results.attack_path: Physical compromise of headlight/radar wiring harness to inject CAN ID 0x120 start command.
results.csg: CSG-04: Mandate AUTOSAR SecOC (Secure Onboard Communication) with AES-CMAC authenticators on Start CAN frames.
